page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a heading in spaced capitals above it. No margin notes, no page number, no running head.
page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment ("manitate", from "Dignitate" or similar), kept as printed. The last line is broken at the line end as "tenui-" with the hyphen kept and continues on the next page. "Vestris" and "potest" use long s as printed; long s is rendered here as s per the transcription rules. Some letters at the left edge of lines are damaged and were read with care.
